# en-standard

## Good example

Getting paid by Example Town Council

Email your invoice to invoices@example.test and put your Purchase Order number in the subject line. We pay within 21 days of receiving an invoice we can match to a Purchase Order. If the number is missing, our system sends the invoice back to you and the 21 days don't start.

Your Purchase Order number is the letters EX followed by six digits, such as EX-104233. It's at the top of the order we emailed you. If you can't find it, ask the person who placed the order. Our accounts team can't look it up, because orders are filed by department and they can't see who your contact was.

Before you send your invoice, check that it shows:

1. your business name and address, spelled as they are on the order
2. the Purchase Order number
3. the date you delivered the goods or finished the work
4. the amount, with tax shown on its own line

If you deliver an order in stages, send one invoice for each delivery. We can't pay a single invoice against two delivery dates.

## Pair 1

### Before

Understanding Framework Agreements

In today's fast-paced procurement landscape, it is important to note the pivotal role of one tool in particular. A Framework Agreement is a contract between an organization and one or more suppliers that sets out the terms under which future purchases can be made over a set period. Rather than agreeing to buy a specific quantity of goods or services at a fixed moment, you and the supplier agree in advance on prices, quality standards, and general conditions. You then place individual orders as the need arises, often through a simpler and faster process.

Organizations leverage framework agreements for several reasons, and the most important is efficiency. Once a framework is in place, your staff do not need to carry out a full competitive procurement each time they need a common item or service. Moreover, this saves time, reduces administrative effort, and shortens the lead time between identifying a need and receiving the goods.

[cut]

### After

Understanding Framework Agreements

A Framework Agreement is a contract between an organization and one or more suppliers that sets out the terms under which future purchases can be made over a set period. Rather than agreeing to buy a specific quantity of goods or services at a fixed moment, you and the supplier agree in advance on prices, quality standards, and general conditions. You then place individual orders as the need arises, often through a simpler and faster process.

Organizations use framework agreements for several reasons, and the most important is efficiency. Once a framework is in place, your staff do not need to run a full competitive procurement each time they need a common item or service. This saves time, reduces administrative effort, and shortens the lead time between identifying a need and receiving the goods.

Framework agreements can also deliver better value. When you combine demand across departments or over a longer period, you may be able to negotiate more favorable prices and terms. Suppliers, in turn, get a clearer picture of expected demand, which can help them plan more reliably.

[cut]

## Pair 2

### Before

Frequently Asked Questions: Registering as a Vendor with the Sample Agency

Who can register as a Vendor?
Any small business that wants to supply goods or services to the Sample Agency can apply to register as a Vendor. Registration is open to businesses of all types that meet the basic requirements described below, ensuring a seamless path into a truly welcoming vendor landscape.

Does it cost anything to register?
No. Registration is free. You will not be asked to make a payment of any fee to submit an application, and you should be cautious of any third party that claims otherwise.

What do I need to register?
It is important to note that you need a valid business number for every application. We will conduct a verification of it as part of the registration process, so please make sure it is accurate and up to date before you apply.

[cut]

### After

Frequently Asked Questions: Registering as a Vendor with the Sample Agency

Who can register as a Vendor?
Any small business that wants to supply goods or services to the Sample Agency can apply to register as a Vendor. Registration is open to businesses of all types that meet the basic requirements described below.

Does it cost anything to register?
No. Registration is free. You will not be asked to pay any fee to submit an application, and you should be cautious of any third party that claims otherwise.

What do I need to register?
You need a valid business number for every application. We will check it as part of the registration process, so please make sure it is accurate and up to date before you apply.

How long does registration take?
Registration can take up to 10 working days. The time needed depends on how complete your application is and how quickly any follow-up questions are answered. Applications with missing information may take longer, so please check your details carefully before you submit.
